title: COMPASS R1 core reproducibility code
description: Core code for the R1 strict focal-species leave-one-out COMPASS aquatic sentinel-panel analysis. Large public and provider-hosted inputs, including EPA ECOTOX, are obtained from their official services and are not mirrored in the compact GitHub code package.
notes: Prepared metadata only. No Zenodo deposition or DOI is claimed for this release. The verifiable public software identifier is the GitHub v1.0.0 release tag.
